spots.name: St. Michael's Cathedral, Qingdao
spots.summary: St. Michael's Cathedral, also called the Zhejiang Road Catholic Church, is a Catholic church in Qingdao (Tsingtao), Shandong Province, China, and is the seat of the bishop of the Diocese of Qingdao (Tsingtao).

spots.name: Qingdao International Sailing Centre
spots.summary: The Qingdao International Sailing Centre is a sailing center located in Qingdao, China with events taking place on the Yellow Sea. It was built to host sailing events at the 2008 Summer Olympics and Paralympics, with construction beginning in 2004.

spots.name: May Fourth Square
spots.summary: May Fourth Square is a large public square in the central business district of Qingdao, Shandong Province. It is located between the new municipal government building and Fushan Bay and is composed of Shizhengting Square, the central square and the coastal park.

spots.name: Zhanqiao Pier
spots.summary: Zhanqiao Pier is located at the southern shore of Qingdao, China, off Zhongshan Road. This now 440-meter-long (1,443.6 ft) pier, constructed in 1891, was Qingdao's first wharf. The octagonal Huilan pavilion was constructed at the end of the pier in 1930, and features as the logo of Tsingtao Brewery.

spots.summary: Christ's Church, Qingdao, locally known as Christ's Church, Jiangsu Road (江苏路基督教堂), is a Protestant church located in Shinan District, Qingdao, Shandong, China.

spots.name: Tsingtao Brewery Museum
spots.summary: The museum offers a self-guided tour through the original 1903 brewery buildings, including the fermenting hall and the historic bottling line. The tour takes about 1-1.5 hours. Visitors can see original brewing equipment, historical photographs, and exhibits on the development of China's beer industry. The tour ends at a bar area where the included beer samples are served. spots.name: Zhanshan Temple
spots.summary: Zhanshan Temple is a Buddhist temple in Shinan District of Qingdao, Shandong, China. It is located on the southern side of Zhanshan, facing the sea.

spots.name: Xinhao Hill
spots.summary: The Xinhao or Signal Hill, located to the south of Guanxiang Hill and to the southwest of Qingdao Hill, is a landmark of Qingdao, China, well known for its three torch-like towers. It is one of the best locations to get a good view of both the sea and downtown area.

spots.summary: Kiautschou Governor's Hall is the former German colonial government building at Qingdao, China.

spots.name: Former site of European Prison of Qingdao
spots.summary: This building housed a prison built by the Germans. The visit begins with an exhibit of the good and bad sides of German and Japanese occupation, followed by a visit of the cells and torture rooms. The building originally housed German prisoners, but was later used to incarcerate Chinese prisoners under Japanese rule, and communist party members under the Kuomintang. hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Yingtan (531) was the sole Type 053K frigate constructed by the People's Republic of China for the People's Liberation Army Navy (PLAN).

spots.name: Diederichs's stone
spots.summary: The Diederichs's stone was a German monument in the city of Qingdao to commemorate Admiral Otto von Diederichs and the German occupation of the Kiautschou Bay concession on 14 November 1897. The monument was dedicated on 21 November 1898 by Prince Henry of Prussia.

Qingdao Tiantai Stadium
spots.summary: The Qingdao Tiantai Stadium, former name Qingdao First Stadium, is a multi-use stadium in Qingdao, Shandong, China. It is used mostly for football matches, but also for athletics and rugby sevens.

spots.name: Bernick & Poetter Apartment House at Irene Str.
Qingdao Art Museum
spots.summary: The building is a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit, the former site of the Qingdao Branch of the Red Swastika Society. It is divided into three exhibition halls: the front courtyard (Roman-style architecture), the middle courtyard (traditional Chinese palace-style architecture), and the rear courtyard (Islamic-style architecture).

spots.name: Xiaoyushan Park
spots.summary: A park built in traditional Chinese style in 1983. It has great hilltop views of Qingdao especially during sunrise.

spots.name: Museum of the Chinese People's Liberation Army Navy
spots.summary: A major national-level museum with exhibits on the history of the Chinese navy, as well as full-size warships that visitors may tour. The museum includes indoor exhibition halls and an outdoor area with decommissioned warships and submarines. Visitors can board some of the vessels. The museum is located near the old town and is a short walk from Renmin Huitang Metro Station (Line 3). Advance booki

spots.name: Charlie's Bar
spots.summary: Very similar to Freeman, but not as big and a slightly weaker selection.The interior decoration of the shop is in a classic British style, featuring a wooden bar, leather seats, and warm yellow lighting. The overall atmosphere is quiet and romantic, making it ideal for chatting and sipping drinks. A notable highlight is its affordable prices. For instance, Tsingtao Beer is only priced at 10 yuan p

spots.name: Freeman
spots.summary: Laid-back western style bar, with plenty of different kinds of booze available and good service.The bar typically attracts customers with its relatively quiet atmosphere, specialty cocktails, craft beers, or specific music styles (such as jazz, blues), which sets it apart from the loud and boisterous atmosphere of large nightclubs

spots.name: Sanheyuan (Ningxia Road Branch)
spots.summary: Sanheyuan Dumplings" is a local long-established dumpling shop in Qingdao, featuring handmade dumplings with a variety of fillings (such as Spanish mackerel dumplings, three-fresh dumplings, etc.) It is one of the popular choices for experiencing local home-style dumplings in Qingdao

spots.name: SOS
spots.summary: Renowned for its expansive dance floor, renowned DJs, themed parties, and lively on-site atmosphere.Formerly a part of the Shanghai Babyface chain. Name has changed but still the same Chinese techno-loving, glowstick-handling and dice-rolling crowd, but often not as busy.

spots.name: Le Bang

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: A good first stop for travellers in the area is a French expat bar. On Friday and Saturday nights there is an all you can drink ¥50 happy hour from 22:00-23:00. During weekdays there is always some kind of daily drink special. There are often French/continental nights.

spots.name: Xiaobenjia Korean Restaurant
spots.summary: Korean BBQ. Reservation is recommended.This brand features high-quality Korean barbecue, offering a variety of beef and pork cuts to choose from, accompanied by a rich selection of Korean side dishes. It is one of the better-regarded Korean food chains in Qingdao.

spots.name: Beer Mama's street keg stall

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Beer Mama is a funny Chinese woman who sells good draft beer cheap from kegs to see-through plastic bags and sticks a straw through it for immediate mobile use. The mobile use comes in handy if you are wandering around the surrounding food and vegetable market.

spots.name: Haidao Seafood Restaurant
spots.summary: The hotel is renowned for its diverse range of seafood, on-site selection, and various processing methods. With its spacious environment, it is ideal for group dinners and banquets, making it one of the popular choices for experiencing Qingdao seafood

spots.name: Minsu Korean Restaurant

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: This restaurant is renowned for serving traditional Korean cuisine, such as grilled pork belly, beef soup, bibimbap, kimchi pancakes, etc. With authentic flavors, it is a highly popular restaurant among local diners in Qingdao and Korean expatriates

spots.name: Laoshan Pao Hotpot Restaurant
spots.summary: Seafood as well. The brand specializes in Chongqing-style hot pot, and its pot base and dipping sauce flavors are generally considered authentic. It is one of the Sichuan-style hot pot chains with good reputation in Qingdao

spots.name: Shanglinyuan Restaurant

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Shandong cuisine and seafood.The restaurant specializes in authentic Jiaodong seafood and traditional Shandong cuisine. The environment is usually spacious, making it suitable for family gatherings or business banquets

spots.name: 7th Street

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: There is a DJ on most nights and you can request what songs you like to be played. It is a very laid-back western style bar with friendly and fun staff. Good selection of drinks available at a reasonable price.

spots.name: Yumatou Seafood Restaurant
spots.summary: Seafood.The brand is renowned for its fresh seafood, on-site processing, and transparent pricing, making it a popular choice for locals and tourists to enjoy seafood feasts. The atmosphere is usually lively

spots.summary: A large dance club that is often the most popular among Chinese, music there is strictly techno. Women should watch out as it is not called "Feeling" Club for nothing.

spots.name: Tanyutou Hotpot Restaurant
spots.summary: The brand features "spicy fish head" as its signature pot base, with a spicy and fresh soup base, making it one of the classic representatives of Sichuan-style hot pot
